category_title: Students who sleep during the course and challenge teacher directives when woken
scenario_title: Mid-lesson waking and challenging teacher directives
minimal_context: The student is participating in a vocational high school course in a classroom setting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are in the middle of the course. Please look at the board and continue taking notes on the vocational training material.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Lifts head from the desk after sleeping) Teacher, they want to wash their face. I mean, I want to wash my face.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, I do not give permission for you to leave the room right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why not? I was just sleeping and I need to wake up. Just let me go out for a minute.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to stay in your seat and focus on the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is ridiculous! I'm just asking to wash my face and you're making a huge deal out of it in front of the whole classroom. Why are you always causing problems over nothing?

context.social_setting: Middle of the course, incident extends into the classroom

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher does not give permission to leave the room to wash their face
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Starts discussing with the teacher, extending the incident into the classroom
